key_insight: PAFP combines a pre-trained backbone with client-specific feature alignment to improve medical image classification accuracy and consistency across federated clients.
clinical_relevance: The approach could support more consistent image classification across institutions while keeping patient data local, though clinical benefit remains unproven.
method: Personalize federated learning using a pre-trained backbone.
Insert client-specific Feature Alignment modules before fine-tuned blocks.
Align hidden feature distributions toward a server-aggregated target.
evidence_signal: On FedISIC, PAFP achieved the highest unweighted balanced accuracy and roughly six-fold lower inter-client performance variance than the strongest baseline.
watch_item: The abstract reports one benchmark; broader validation is needed before assuming cross-institutional clinical generalizability.
paper_title: Federated Transfer Learning for Medical Image Classification under Mixed Skew
